slides.heading: 3 steps that matter most
steps: Author a held-out eval of real tasks before any architecture.
Persist what the system must recall, structured over vector.
Prove each retained component earns its place; report honestly.
slides.alt: DejaViewed carousel, slide 6 of 9. The system. 3 steps that matter most. 1. Build the eval (the oracle): Author a held-out eval of real tasks before any architecture. 2. Memory layer (structured first): Persist what the system must recall, structured over vector. 3. Ablation, noise re-check, gap report: Prove each retained component earns its place; report honestly.

slides.heading: How you know it worked
items: On the held-out eval, the full architecture beats the single-prompt baseline by more than the run-to-run variance, on a stated metric.
The ablation table shows every retained component drops the eval score when removed (beyond the noise floor); cut components do not.
slides.alt: DejaViewed carousel, slide 7 of 9. Proof. How you know it worked.
